connectsTo: The owner's QuickBooks Online company (OAuth, using an Intuit developer app).
permissions: QuickBooks Online accounting scope. TO VERIFY: Intuit's accounting scope is believed to be read and write with no read-only variant, so read-only depends on the server flags below.
riskNote: Official Intuit repository (Apache-2.0 in its LICENSE file, although its README says MIT: the reviewer should note the mismatch). It has no tagged releases and is not on npm, so it is pinned to a commit. It also exposes create, update and delete tools by default. Run it with QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE, QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_UPDATE and QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_DELETE all set to true so only get_* and search_* tools are registered (invoices, customers, aged receivables). Tokens are written to a .env file on the host and the refresh token rotates and lapses after 100 days of disuse. The README mentions no telemetry. Handles invoice amounts and customer balances.
